description:
Implement the load-time half of the registry.

**In scope:**
- `OctoPi.AI.Runner` behaviour (callbacks: `api/0`, `default_base_url/0`, `auth/0`, `validate/1`, `lookup/2`, `discover/1`).
- `OctoPi.AI.Api` behaviour (`stream/4`).
- `OctoPi.AI.RunnerRegistry` — atom→module map, registered at compile-time, swappable via app env for tests.
- `OctoPi.AI.Auth` — resolves `:none | {:env, ...} | {:literal, ...} | {:cmd, ...}` strategies, reads `auth.json` for overrides.
- `OctoPi.AI.ModelRegistry`:
  - `load!(opts)` — reads models.json, validates schema, builds `{(provider, id) => Model.t()}` map, caches via `:persistent_term`.
  - `find/2`, `resolve/1` (strict `runner/model-id`, fallback to `Runner.lookup/2`, side-effect-free).
  - `runners/0`, `models/1`, `all/0`.
- JSON schema validation: per-entry `runner`/`base_url`/`headers`/`api`/`compat`/`models` shape; per-model `id` required, others optional with defaults.
- File location: `~/.octo_pi/models.json` and `~/.octo_pi/auth.json`, overridable via `config :octo_pi, :models_file` / `:auth_file`.
- `Model` struct rename in `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/model.ex`: keep field names `provider` and `api` but document new semantics (provider = runner name, api = wire codec).

**Tests:**
- Load valid models.json with anthropic + lmstudio entries.
- Load with `runner` field for renamed key.
- Validation failures produce path-formatted errors.
- Missing files → empty registry, no crash.
- Auth resolution for each strategy (with `cmd` injectable for tests).
- `resolve/1` strict form, miss falls through to runner stub, `:unsupported` returns clear error.

**Out of scope:** real runner implementations (separate tickets).
title: Foundation: schema, ModelRegistry, Auth, Runner/Api behaviours
